schemas.name: ghGetFileContent
schemas.description: Read a known GitHub file or exact region at a selected ref. Exact by default. Use matchString for a known anchor, line ranges for known lines, minify:symbols to orient, and fullContent only for the whole file. Use ghSearch to find paths and ghCloneRepo for repeated cross-file analysis.

debug.description: Include structured execution evidence, diagnostics, and probe metadata.

branch.description: Exact branch, tag, or commit ref; defaults to the repository default branch.

path.description: Repository-relative file path; exact case, no leading slash.

contextLines.description: Source lines before/after each match; omission uses 5 for line chunks. An explicit value survives byte continuations.

chunkType.description: Page in source-view lines or UTF-8 bytes; omission uses lines. Oversized lines continue by bytes.

offset.description: Zero-based view offset in chunkType units. Byte offsets must be UTF-8 code-point boundaries; copy the returned continuation.

limit.description: Page size in chunkType units; omission uses 100 lines for unscoped reads, or fills the 16384-byte budget for selected ranges/matches. Byte pages default to 16384 bytes. Explicit limits are honored; byte ends may expand to preserve a code point.

minify.description: "none" preserves exact redacted source; "symbols" returns code signatures or Markdown headings with source lines; "standard" may remove comments or formatting. Matches force none. contentView/minifyFallback reports an unavailable outline.

forceRefresh.description: Bypass the 24h fetch cache and re-read from GitHub.

fullContent.description: Request the whole file view in one response, up to 50,000 UTF-8 bytes; larger recoverable views return next.continue.

relations: Choose at most one extraction mode: fullContent, startLine+endLine, or matchString; a path-only read is valid.

chunkType selects lines (default) or UTF-8 bytes of the returned view; offset is zero-based.

Match options and contextBytes require matchString; contextLines and contextBytes are exclusive. Omitted context uses 5 lines or 256 UTF-8 bytes according to chunkType; explicit units survive continuations.

schemas.name: localFetch
schemas.description: Read a known local file or exact region. Exact by default. Use matchString for a known anchor, line ranges for known lines, minify:symbols to orient, and fullContent only for the whole file. Exact pages include sourceLineRanges; text output labels source lines while structured content stays undecorated. Use localSearch or astSearch to locate an unknown target, then pass the fetched URI/name/line—not view offsets—to lspSearch.

reasoning.description: Why this query advances the goal.

debug.description: Include structured execution evidence, diagnostics, and probe metadata.

path.description: Local file path; use an absolute path to avoid cwd-dependent resolution.

contextLines.description: Source lines before/after each match; omission uses 5 for line chunks. An explicit value survives byte continuations.

chunkType.description: Page in source-view lines or UTF-8 bytes; omission uses lines. Oversized lines continue by bytes.

offset.description: Zero-based view offset in chunkType units. Byte offsets must be UTF-8 code-point boundaries; copy the returned continuation.

limit.description: Page size in chunkType units; omission uses 100 lines for unscoped reads, or fills the 16384-byte budget for selected ranges/matches. Byte pages default to 16384 bytes. Explicit limits are honored; byte ends may expand to preserve a code point.

minify.description: "none" preserves exact redacted source; "symbols" returns code signatures or Markdown headings with source lines; "standard" may remove comments or formatting. Matches force none. contentView/minifyFallback reports an unavailable outline.

fullContent.description: Request the whole file view in one response, up to 50,000 UTF-8 bytes; larger recoverable views return next.continue.

relations: Choose at most one extraction mode: fullContent, startLine+endLine, or matchString; a path-only read is valid.
fullContent rejects chunk controls; minify:"symbols" rejects ranges and matchString.
chunkType selects lines (default) or UTF-8 bytes of the returned view; offset is zero-based.

Match options and contextBytes require matchString; contextLines and contextBytes are exclusive. Omitted context uses 5 lines or 256 UTF-8 bytes according to chunkType; explicit units survive continuations.
guidance: Batch 1–5 independent queries in queries[] per call; keep dependent probes sequential.
Local path: use an absolute path; relative paths resolve from command cwd.
